name: lci_status
description: GET /status CBOR payload vectors (spec 11-lci.md section 17.5.3). Pins the node status document: uptime_s, battery_pct, battery_mv, mem_free_kb and the nested time/dodag/radio/ccp objects. Bytes are produced by StatusResource.render_get over StaticNodeInfo (lichen.coap.resources.node_resources); encoded_hex equals cbor2.dumps of the pinned input. /status is a read-only GET surface with no rejection path, so this family has no negative vectors.

vectors.name: status_empty
vectors.description: Fresh node with no telemetry: empty status map encodes as a0.

vectors.name: status_minimal
vectors.description: Minimal status: uptime 120 s, battery 64 %, 3700 mV. Nested objects omitted.

vectors.name: status_full_spec_example
vectors.description: Full status document matching the spec 17.5.3 example: GNSS-disciplined time, joined DODAG (rank 512), radio counters with fractional duty cycle (2.3 -> 8-byte float), CCP scheduler state.

vectors.name: status_wall_clock_invalid
vectors.description: No wall clock (spec: unix_time omitted when wall_clock_valid is false) and unjoined DODAG at infinite rank 65535 with null parent/root.
